notes: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא → 'that day': preposition, assimilated article and agreement article all unrepresented; הוּא takes 'that' (rules 12, 41, 47).
לָכֵן → 'wherefore' fused, headed on the opening morpheme as a compound of function morphemes (rule 23); כֵן is the competing head.
הָיְתָה לְ → 'pertaineth unto': each morpheme has a word of its own, so no fusion.
